note: Reduced rule pack for the public site build. It carries only rules whose provenance is publishable literature. Rules sourced from internal documents are disabled outright rather than left unsourced, because a lint rule discloses through its message as well as its citation. This file is bundled into the shipped JavaScript, so it must not describe what it withholds — the reasoning and the full pack live in the studio repository. Check there, and the Polymer Biologics document register, before enabling anything below.

PKR-DSRNA-HELIX.source: [CONFLICT] — Wayment-Steele et al., "Theoretical basis for stabilizing messenger RNA through secondary structure design" (pmc/PMC7457604) [REVIEW] gives 33 bp, flagging helices longer than that as the threshold associated with PKR activation, and keeps its optimised low-AUP designs at 8–22 bp. The >~30 bp figure is [UNVERIFIED]. Neither number traces to primary PKR biochemistry. Design against 30 bp: this is a safety check for a design-killing defect, where a false flag costs a second look and a miss costs an interferon response.
